examples.title: Example 1: Adding Graphical Transformation Effects
examples.description: This example applies rotation, translation, scaling, and transformation matrix effects to the component using rotate, translate, scale, and transform.

examples.title: Example 2: Setting the Rotation Perspective
examples.description: This example demonstrates how to set the rotation perspective for a component by using perspective.

examples.title: Example 3: Implementing Rotation Around a Center Point
examples.description: This example shows how to achieve the same rotation effect by setting different parameters for rotate and transform.

examples.title: Example 4: Implementing Graphical Transformation Through transform3D
examples.description: This example demonstrates how to implement image transformation by setting transform3D. This functionality is supported since API version 20.

examples.title: Example 5: Rotating an Image Based on Angles of Each Axis
examples.description: This example demonstrates how to implement rotation by setting the RotateAngleOptions parameter of rotate. This functionality is supported since API version 20.
